title: Chennai Love Story Box Office Collection Day 3: Beats SK Kalyana Mandapam To Become Kiran Abbavaram's 3rd Highest Grossing Film
summary: Telugu romantic drama Chennai Love Story opened July 24 and posted a strong opening weekend in India, collecting a net total of 16.7 crore (Friday 4.95 cr, Saturday 5.5 cr, Sunday 6.25 cr). It has overtaken Kiran Abbavaram’s SK Kalyana Mandapam (11.31 cr) to become his third-highest grosser. Made on a 30 crore budget, it has recovered over 50% and needs about 13.3 crore more to reach the safe zone. Directed by Ravi Namburi; music by Mani Sharma.
content:
Home»Box Office

The recently released Telugu film Chennai Love Story has taken the box office by storm. The romantic drama was released in theatres on July 24, at a time when most filmmakers pushed their release date to make way for Jana Nayagan. Chennai Love Story had limited buzz and did not move their release date. The faith of the makers on their film has borne fruit as the film has registered an impressive opening weekend collection.

The Telugu romantic film was the audience’s pick of the weekend, especially in the Telugu-speaking states. The film opened at the box office in India at4.95 crore. The film saw a good growth over the weekend, collecting5.5 croreon Saturday nd6.25 croreon Sunday. The film’s net total stands at16.7 crore.

Total: 16.7 crore

With this,Chennai Love Storyhas beaten Kiran Abbavaram’s SK Kalyana Mandapam. As a result, the actor’s latest romantic film has overtaken his previous hit to claim the third-highest-grossing spot in his career. SK Kalyana Mandapam had earned a net collection of11.31 croreduring its theatrical run. Meanwhile, Chennai Love Story is now on track to become Kiran’s highest-grossing film. Currently, KA (2024) holds that record with a total collection of26.94 crore.

The film was reportedly made on a budget of30 crore, and has earned16.7 crorenet so far. The Telegu drama has recovered over50%of its budget. The film needs more than13.3 croreto enter the safe zone.

Chennai Love Story is directed by Ravi Namburi and produced by Srinivasa Kumar and Sai Rajesh under the banners Mass Movie Makers and Amrutha Productions. The music is composed by Mani Sharma.

## Chennai Love Story — Box Office

Home » Box Office

The recently released Telugu film Chennai Love Story has taken the box office by storm. The romantic drama was released in theatres on July 24, at a time when most filmmakers pushed their release date to make way for Jana Nayagan. Chennai Love Story had limited buzz and did not move their release date. The faith of the makers on their film has borne fruit as the film has registered an impressive opening weekend collection.

The Telugu romantic film was the audience’s pick of the weekend, especially in the Telugu-speaking states. The film opened at the box office in India at 4.95 crore. The film saw a good growth over the weekend, collecting 5.5 crore on Saturday and 6.25 crore on Sunday. The film’s net total stands at 16.7 crore.

Total: 16.7 crore

## Comparison and Rankings

With this, Chennai Love Story has beaten Kiran Abbavaram’s SK Kalyana Mandapam. As a result, the actor’s latest romantic film has overtaken his previous hit to claim the third-highest-grossing spot in his career. SK Kalyana Mandapam had earned a net collection of 11.31 crore during its theatrical run. Meanwhile, Chennai Love Story is now on track to become Kiran’s highest-grossing film. Currently, KA (2024) holds that record with a total collection of 26.94 crore.

## Budget and Break-even

The film was reportedly made on a budget of 30 crore, and has earned 16.7 crore net so far. The Telugu drama has recovered over 50% of its budget. The film needs more than 13.3 crore to enter the safe zone.

## Credits

- Director: Ravi Namburi
- Producers: Srinivasa Kumar and Sai Rajesh
- Production banners: Mass Movie Makers and Amrutha Productions
- Music: Mani Sharma
